original_ai_output.title_zh: 据报八名MTN员工在西赤道州被扣押
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹西赤道州地方当局称，八名MTN光纤网络施工人员于2026年10月29日在坦布拉与纳格罗两县之间的公路上遭伏击后，被武装反对派力量扣押在班达拉地区。当局呼吁立即无条件释放这些工人。一名县专员称，扣押方以一名儿童据称死亡为由索要3500万南苏丹镑赔偿，但索要金额说法不一，且尚未获得交叉验证。SPLA-IO方面未回应置评请求。

location.raw_text: Bandala, along the road between Tambura and Nagero counties, Western Equatoria State, South Sudan

key_facts.fact: 据报八名MTN光纤网络施工人员被武装反对派力量扣押在西赤道州班达拉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Local authorities in South Sudan’s Western Equatoria State have called for the immediate and unconditional release of eight MTN fibre-optic workers detained by armed opposition forces in Bandala

key_facts.fact: 事件发生于2026年10月29日，四辆载有八人的车辆在坦布拉与纳格罗之间的公路上遭伏击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the incident occurred on October 29, 2026, when four vehicles carrying eight people were travelling from Wau through Nagero towards Source Yubu

key_facts.fact: 一名县专员称扣押方索要3500万南苏丹镑作为一名儿童据称死亡的赔偿
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: condemned the reported detention of three vehicles by SPLA-IO forces in Bandala, allegedly over a demand for 35 million South Sudanese pounds (SSP)

key_facts.fact: SPLA-IO代表在发稿前未回应置评请求
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: SPLA-IO representatives had not responded to requests for comment on the reported detention, the alleged financial demands or the accusations made by local authorities by the time of publication

uncertainties: 扣押事件及索要赎金的具体细节尚未获得SPLA-IO方面确认
索要金额说法不一：一名官员称3500万南苏丹镑，另一名官员称不清楚具体金额
被扣押人员的确切人数与车辆数量在不同官员表述中存在差异（八名工人/三辆车）
事件目前主要依据当地官员向Radio Tamazuj的单方面陈述，尚缺乏独立交叉验证
